tema: Articles — a / an / the · Ola C: El Viaje del Equipaje Perdido

banco_oraciones.oracion: Kenji has a ticket and a suitcase.
The plane leaves in an hour.
There is a taxi in front of the hotel.
Ben carries an old backpack and a map.
The taxi isn't at the door.
Kenji doesn't have a map of the city.
Is there a hotel near the airport?
Is the hotel open? Yes, it is.
Do you have a map? No, I don't.
Is this the right taxi? Yes, it is.

interaccion: Kenji: I have **a** ticket, **a** suitcase and **an** hour before **the** plane.
Ben: I have **a** backpack and **a** map. **The** map is from 1998, but it is **a** beautiful map.
Sofía: **The** taxi is at **the** door. Don't lose **the** ticket, Ben.
Abuela Carmen: **A** traveler without **a** plan finds **an** adventure. **The** adventure finds **the** rest.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: I have a ticket and a suitcase.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Articles present a noun: a/an for one thing among many (any taxi), the for the specific one in the story (the plane we must catch) — and English needs them even where Spanish doesn't.

tabla.titulo: a / an / the — en el viaje
filas: a ticket, a map, a hotel
an hour, an old backpack, an airport
the specific one in the story
the plane, the door, the ticket
English needs it: She is A pilot

ejercicios.afirmacion: We say 'an hour' because the 'h' is silent: the SOUND is a vowel.
You can say 'I have ticket' without an article in English.

guion: Kenji: Ben, do you have the ticket?
Ben: Yes... no. Wait. I have a map, a sandwich and an old backpack.
Kenji: Ben! The plane leaves in an hour!
Ben: Relax. There is a taxi at the door and a ticket in my pocket.
Ben: That is an excellent question.

opciones: A map, a sandwich and a backpack

reading.texto: Kenji writes in his diary: 'Today Ben almost lost the ticket. We arrived at the airport with an hour to spare. There was a long line at the door, and a dog slept next to a suitcase — an enormous suitcase with a map on top. Ben talked to a pilot about the weather. The pilot said the plane was on time. In the end, the ticket was in Ben's pocket the whole time. It is always an adventure with Ben. Next week: the hotel. I am afraid.'

preguntas.afirmacion: A dog slept next to a suitcase.
The pilot said the plane was late.
The ticket was in Ben's pocket.
